caveats.sell_through: Computed only over houses that publish unsold lots (Pundole's). AstaGuru and Saffronart list sold lots only, so a figure spanning all three would read ~100% and be false. Each artist names its own basis.
caveats.index_quality: Per-square-inch holds size and medium constant but NOT quality. A percentage move is consignment-weighted, not quality-adjusted — always read it with the two medians and the two sample sizes beside it.
caveats.index: Median price per square inch within one medium class, rebased. Derived from tracked public results, not a vendor index. Only lots carrying a medium and size can contribute — see each artist's index_houses. Median and high figures cover every house; the index may cover fewer.
caveats.coverage: AstaGuru, Saffronart and Pundole's. Christie's blocks automated access; Sotheby's not yet ingested.
